It is on many of her teams in the [[core series|video games]] and in some series of [[Pokémon manga]]. There have also been [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] cards named for this Pokémon. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|OS}}==== [[File:Sabrina and Kadabra.png|thumb|220px|Kadabra and Sabrina]] Kadabra first appeared as an Abra in ''[[EP022|Abra and the Psychic Showdown]]''. Sabrina used it in a [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} against {{Ash}}. During the battle with [[Ash's Pikachu]], Abra evolved into a Kadabra and with its {{type|Psychic}} attacks, it eventually caused Ash to forfeit the match to save Pikachu from being hurt anymore. It was shown that Sabrina and Kadabra share a strong psychic bond. Ash later returned for a rematch in ''[[EP024|Haunter versus Kadabra]]''. This time, [[Sabrina's Haunter|Ash's Haunter]] made Sabrina laugh for the first time in years, which caused Kadabra to laugh due to the psychic bond it has with Sabrina. Due to this, Sabrina decided to give the {{badge|Marsh}} to Ash. Kadabra was seen in flashbacks in ''[[EP023|The Tower of Terror]]'' and ''[[EP073|Bad To The Bone]]''. ===Personality and characteristics=== Due to the strong psychic bond between Kadabra and Sabrina, all of Kadabra's emotions completely reflect those of Sabrina, making Kadabra's individual personality unknown. ===Appearance=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{psychic |move3=Future Sight|move3type=Psychic |move4=Calm Mind|move4type=Psychic}} {{Pokémon/Grid/end}} ===Pokémon Stadium series=== {{Pokémon |gen=1 |caption='''{{g|Stadium}}
[[Gym Leader Castle]] Round 1''' |ndex=0064 |pokemon=Kadabra |level=50-100 |type1=Psychic |move1=Disable|move1type=Normal |move2=Psybeam|move2type=Psychic |move3=Reflect|move3type=Psychic |move4=Seismic Toss|move4type=Fighting}} ===In the side series=== ====[[Pokémon Puzzle League]]==== Abra is one of [[Sabrina]]'s three Pokémon in {{g|Puzzle League}}. ==In the manga== ===The Electric Tale of Pikachu=== [[File:Sabrina Abra EToP.png|thumb|200px|Abra in The Electric Tale of Pikachu]] [[File:Sabrina and Abra EToP.png|thumb|left|200px|Abra and Sabrina]] Sabrina's Abra appeared in ''[[ET04|Haunting My Dreams]]''. It had a one-on-one Gym battle against {{AP|Pikachu}}. Abra was able to battle despite sleeping. Pikachu launched multiple {{m|Thunder Shock}}s which was dodged by Abra's {{m|Teleport}}. One of them was redirected at Pikachu which costed {{Ash}} the match. Later in the same chapter, Abra helps Ash and {{an|Brock}} rescue Sabrina from a giant {{p|Haunter}} named the [[Black Fog]]. It defended the two by neutralizing the Black Fog's {{m|Psychic}}. It was weakened by the Black Fog and Abra was about to get eaten by the giant Pokémon but Pikachu managed to save it. Abra then worked with Pikachu to battle the Black Fog in order for Ash to catch it. They were able to weaken it but it used {{m|Self-Destruct}} after Ash threw an Ultra Ball at it to prevent itself from being captured. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|Psychic||Sabrina Abra Teleport EToP.png|Using Teleport}} {{anmov|Psychic|Teleport|ET04|Haunting My Dreams}} {{anmov/f|Psychic}} ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Sabrina Kadabra Adventures.png|200px|thumb|Kadabra in Pokémon Adventures]] [[File:Sabrina and Kadabra Adventures.png|thumb|left|200px|Kadabra and Sabrina in Pokémon Adventures]] Sabrina possesses a Kadabra, which was first seen in ''[[PS020|Meanwhile...Vileplume!]]'', posing as {{adv|Professor Oak}} in his laboratory. When he began to attack {{adv|Red}} and subsequently was tangled in [[Saur]]'s vine in retaliation, his use of a {{m|Psybeam}} revealed that he was a Pokémon. A {{m|Leech Seed}} attack then unmasked him, and soon he teleported back to Sabrina's side, aiding in the siege in [[Saffron City]]. In ''[[PS030|Zap! Zap! Zapdos!]]'', Kadabra battles against {{adv|Green}}. Although Sabrina initially appeared to be daunted by her {{m|Smokescreen}} (among other various tricks), Sabrina is able to get the edge easily with Kadabra's psychic powers. After Green only managed to escape the opponent even [[Blasty]] couldn't take out, Kadabra and his Trainer soon caught up to her and called upon the other {{p|Articuno|legendary}} {{p|Zapdos|birds}}, who soon merged into {{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Thu-Fi-Zer}}. In following arcs, he hasn't been seen much (owing to Sabrina's minor role), but continued to be among the strongest fighters she has, despite her also possessing {{p|Alakazam|his evolved form}} as well. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|Psychic||Sabrina Kadabra {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Psychic|1=Psybeam|2=Disable|3=Hypnosis|4=Teleport}} Adventures.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Psychic|1=Psybeam|2=Disable|3=Hypnosis|4=Teleport}}}} {{anmov|Psychic|Teleport|PS020|Meanwhile...Vileplume!}} {{anmov|Psychic|Hypnosis|PS027|Kalling Kadabra{{tt|*|Kadabra could not legally learn Hypnosis at the time}}}} {{anmov|Psychic|Psybeam|PS027|Kalling Kadabra}} {{anmov|Psychic|Psychic|PS030|Zap! Zapdos!|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|Psychic}} ===Pokémon Pocket Monsters=== [[File:Sabrina Kadabra PM.png|150px|thumb|Kadabra in Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] [[File:Sabrina and Kadabra PM.png|150px|thumb|left|Kadabra and Sabrina in Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] Sabrina's Kadabra appeared in ''[[PM012|The Life-or-Death Magic Duel!!]]''. Sabrina summoned her Kadabra from her crystal ball after {{PPM|Red}}, {{TP|Red|Clefairy}} and {{PPM|Red's Pikachu|Pikachu}} arrived in her castle. She did so in order for it to challenge Clefairy to a magic game. Kadabra performed many tricks such as bending a spoon. As Clefairy took his turn to perform some tricks, he had Kadabra light up the magical box when Clefairy went inside. However, the box accidentally lit up the dynamite that was attached to it. Much to the surprise of Kadabra and the others, the dynamite exploded and it blew up the whole castle. {{-}} ==In the TCG== Abra and Kadabra are featured in the TCG as one of [[Sabrina]]'s Pokémon. {{color2|000|Yamabuki City Gym (TCG)|Yamabuki City Gym}} {{color2|000|Theme Deck (TCG)|Theme Deck}} |} ===Merchandise=== ====Yamabuki City Gym Deck==== In a similar fashion to the associated {{TCG|Leaders' Stadium}} decks, two more decks featuring [[Gym Leader]]s were released on February 26, 1999. [[Sabrina]] and her principally {{ct|Psychic}} Pokémon would later feature as part of the {{TCG|Challenge from the Darkness}} expansion, but debuted in the '''{{TCG|Yamabuki City Gym}}''' (Japanese: '''ヤマブキシティジム ナツメ''') Deck. The deck includes 64 cards, a coin, a rulebook, and a Pokémon Gym Guide.
